title: bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2: plain distinguished-point rho in GT (v2)

claims.statement: For a uniform nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 and an independent uniform z in GT, the attack in proof.md returns Q=[a]Q0 in G2 with e(P,Q)=z under the pinned pairing convention, using at most 2^127.80 total target-group-operation equivalents (dense Fp12 multiplications, C=20,000). It computes g=e(P,Q0) and solves z=g^a by a standard van Oorschot-Wiener parallel distinguished-point Pollard rho on the cyclic group GT of prime order r. There is no automorphism or orbit quotient and hence no fruitless cycles: the only assumption is the textbook random-mapping model for the rho collision time, supported by toy experiments. Each step is one dense Fp12 multiplication plus ~300 scalar instructions; 1.015 units per step are charged. Distinguished points use theta=2^-30 (chosen to keep the table small); walks restart at every distinguished point via a cheap rule (new start = previous distinguished point times a random table entry, one multiplication), so the ~2^97.8 restarts cost ~2^97.8 units, far below the main term and fully charged. The budget is 1.25*sqrt(2*r*ln(1/0.61)) useful steps, giving random-mapping success 0.538 >= 0.39. Additive setup, restart, distinguished-point storage, detection-lag and output costs are all negligible against the main term. Peak memory is bounded hard by a fixed table of 2^100 distinguished-point slots (the stochastic record count has mean 2^97.74 and exceeds 2^100 only with doubly-exponentially small probability by Chernoff, not binding before the collision, so success >=0.39 is preserved): at most 2^108 bytes. Preprocessing is at most 2^32 units and is included; nonuniform advice is 0 bytes. This is a classical cold attack with no uncharged advice or quantum steps; generic square-root accounting, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Run a standard R-adding distinguished-point Pollard rho with parallel walks and cheap D*M_j restarts in a prime-order-l subgroup of F_q^* (cyclic, standing in for GT). No automorphism, no fruitless cycles. Count every group multiplication of the walk and restarts. Report mean multiplications relative to sqrt(pi*l/2) and the success fraction within the 1.25*k0 budget. Toy-scale evidence for the random-mapping collision-time model only.
